one_line_contribution: A pre-registered 2x2 provenance experiment in ALFWorld that puts a number, with a confidence interval, on how much of a procedural memory bank's task-type-specific advantage is already held by a GEPA-style instruction optimized on the very same training episodes: the absorbed share A = 1 - Inner(I_own)/Inner(I_oth), with an episode-disjoint same-type instruction (Ladder T, row 4) splitting that share into an episode-level component A_epi and a type-level component A_type.
closest_prior_work: The proposal itself names the two that matter and concedes both, which is to its credit and also caps it: EvoAgentBench (arXiv 2607.05202) already puts ReasoningBank (+3.6) and GEPA (+1.2) on the same 528/267 trajectories, so the qualitative headline is published; MIPROv2 (arXiv 2406.11695) already established the instruction-versus-demonstration ablation on one training set; ExpeL (arXiv 2308.10144) already stores its memory as a prepended natural-language block, so the two containers are not architecturally distinct in the closest target system. What the Related Work does not engage, and what threatens more than the concession admits, is the ALFWorld-specific manual/guideline line: AutoManual (arXiv 2405.16247, NeurIPS 2024) builds rules from ALFWorld interaction and compiles them into a single markdown manual that replaces per-episode experience lookup, and AutoGuide (arXiv 2403.08978) extracts state-aware guidelines from offline experience and retrieves them. Between them they already establish, in this exact environment, that episodic experience can be rewritten as instruction text and that a compiled manual is competitive with retrieval - which is most of the conceptual content of the compiled-block arm (row 11) and prediction 6, and a large part of the memory-as-instruction framing. Neither performs the provenance crossover, so the identification instrument survives; but the proposal's claim that the compile-once result is a quantified bound rather than a surprise is understated - AutoManual makes it closer to a replication.
strongest_objection: The confirmatory endpoint is not identified against the most obvious rival, and its decision threshold sits on its own measured noise floor. A = 1 - Inner(I_own)/Inner(I_oth) is a ratio of two on-type-minus-off-type contrasts, and it rises whenever the denominator condition is more bank-dependent - not only when content has moved from episodes into I_own. I_oth is an instruction that a reflective optimizer tuned for the other task set (e.g. an instruction shaped around clean/cool/heat, run on pick_and_place games). A mis-specified instruction gives an on-type bank more to repair, inflating Inner(I_oth) and hence A with zero absorption. The plan has no arm that separates this: Ladder T (row 4) is same-type by construction, so mismatch inflation flows entirely into A_type, and the pre-registered rule in prediction 4 reads A_epi near zero with A_type >= 0.4 as task-type-granular absorption, with the practical conclusion declared unchanged and arguably stronger. So the single most likely benign explanation of a positive result is routed, in advance, into a branch reported as a success. Row 1 gives Inner(I0*) and could diagnose exactly this, but the plan never pre-registers a comparison of Inner(I_oth) against Inner(I0*) as a denominator-inflation check. Layered on top: prediction 1 demands a 90% lower bound >= 0.2, while section (c) expects the treatment-free null replicate (row 10) to sit at 0.12-0.21, i.e. the claim's decision boundary is roughly where the ratio lands with no treatment at all; the pre-registered remedy is to raise n from the balanced reserve, but that reserve is about 230 pooled games (T_B binds at 116) and is already promised to the single G3 re-measurement in the [6,9) window and to any S_test shortfall at freeze. The same games cannot be spent three times, so the only remedy actually available is raising the threshold, which weakens the claim. With G3 described as a deliberate coin flip at a true 9pt effect and power of about 70% at the projected 8pt denominator, the joint probability of a conclusive confirmatory reading is well under half, and the outcome that does arrive is not cleanly separable from instruction mismatch.
what_would_fix_it: 1. Promote I_all x {B_own, B_oth} to Tier 0 and pre-register A against three denominators - Inner(I0*), Inner(I_all) and Inner(I_oth) - with a rule that the absorption claim requires agreement across them. If Inner(I_oth) materially exceeds Inner(I0*), the denominator is inflated by instruction mismatch and A is not interpretable as absorption; this is nearly free, since I_all is already built for row 5. 2. Make the deployment quantity co-primary rather than secondary. Prediction 6 currently asserts the practitioner conclusion from a bounded loss - the 90% CI of g(I_all, B_all) lying below 3pt - but at n = 800 the CI half-width is 1.7-2.3pt, so that bound is satisfied by a true gain of 2.5pt, half the gated 5pt effect. Replace it with a formal equivalence test against a pre-specified margin, powered accordingly, since that is the number a practitioner would act on and the number the title implicitly claims. 3. Take the frontier reflector the track explicitly budgets for (a few hundred dollars for the reflection/optimizer role). Refusing it because no key is on the node is a self-inflicted handicap that makes G2 a live failure branch, shrinks the level gap the study needs, and weakens I_own - the proposal argues this is conservative for A, but it mainly lowers the chance the study concludes at all. 4. Run pre-freeze obligation (1) - the provenance-crossover search in the contamination and data-attribution literatures - before submission rather than before the design freeze, and open the appendix of arXiv 2608.14036. The novelty claim is explicitly conditional on both, and a conditional novelty claim is not a novelty claim. 5. Resolve the reserve arithmetic: the allocation table lists S_screen as its own 150-per-set line while the screening section says S_screen is drawn from the reserve, and the same ~230-game balanced reserve is separately promised to G3 extension, null-floor remediation and S_test shortfall. Either enlarge T_B (the official valid_seen and valid_unseen sets are currently held out for a Tier-1 check) or cut arms.
missing_baseline: Inner at the deployed instruction: I_all x {B_own, B_oth}. Row 5 runs I_all only against M0 and B_all, so the relevance advantage is never measured at the pooled instruction a practitioner would actually ship - the one instruction in the design that is optimizer-exposed but not provenance-labelled toward either type set. Its absence is what leaves the I_oth denominator unchecked and what forces the deployment claim to rest on a single absolute gain with a 2pt-wide CI. A second, cheaper omission from Tier 0: raw retrieved trajectories at I_own with no distillation. The proposal's own cited audit (arXiv 2603.02473) reports that raw chunks match lossy writes, so if undistilled trajectories retain the advantage at the optimized instruction while distilled items do not, the finding is about distillation rather than absorption. R_raw exists only as part of a Tier-1 long-context dump ladder and is cuttable.
preprint_collision: Not thin - this is among the more disciplined collision checks I have seen in a proposal: two dated scans (2026-08-21, 2026-09-03), 15 HuggingFace queries over 244 papers, by-id verification of 54 arXiv IDs, a full 15-page PDF read of the closest competitor with the extracted text committed under SHA256, a self-correction of a misreported ReasoningBank number (+7 to +3.6), and reinstatement of five IDs wrongly retracted in v2. It should be credited as a model of the practice. But it establishes collision, not clearance. The proposal's own finding is that EvoAgentBench (arXiv 2607.05202) already publishes the qualitative claim on shared training trajectories, so what remains is instrument plus number - the authors say so plainly, which is honest but is also the ceiling on the novelty score. Three residual weaknesses are real. First, the one search that would settle the novelty claim - held-out-episode and data-provenance crossovers in the prompt-optimization, contamination and data-attribution literatures - has never been run from this node and is deferred as a freeze-blocking obligation; a novelty claim conditional on an unrun search is not established, and this is a weakness rather than a neutral. Second, arXiv is unreachable from the node, so most 2026 IDs rest on a single channel and every confirmed absent from the paper claim except EvoAgentBench's is asserted from an abstract - which is precisely the evidence standard that would miss a GEPA-plus-memory ablation buried in a systems-paper appendix, the residual risk the proposal itself names. Third, the check looks forward but not back: AutoManual (arXiv 2405.16247) and AutoGuide (arXiv 2403.08978) already convert ALFWorld experience into a compiled manual and into retrievable guidelines respectively, and neither appears anywhere in the scan. That is a pre-2026 collision with the compile-once arm (row 11) and prediction 6 that a recency-weighted preprint sweep structurally could not catch, and it suggests the scan's calibration is tilted too far toward the last six months.
